title: Without Delete, the part dialog shows no Delete Part button
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Staff member {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-NODEL-DELBTN) works at {Location-A} with the custom role {Role-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-DELBTN-ROLE), which has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and See Financial Data but not 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete'.
  • {User-B} is signed in in a second browser window (for example a private window), and the Admin stays signed in in the first window.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-DELBTN-01) is active at {Location-A}, with 2 in {Bin-A}, and is on no work order.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab in both windows.
custom_steps:
1. In the Admin window search {Part-A} and click its row.
  2. Look at the left end of the footer, then click Cancel.
  3. In {User-B}'s window search {Part-A} and click its row.
  4. Look at the left end of the footer.
  5. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The Admin sees the red Delete Part button at the left of the footer.
  • Step 4: {User-B} sees no Delete Part button; the footer holds only Cancel and Save.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S8-R12, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.1 (The part as it stands; Delete Part in the footer), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R12: “Delete Part in the part dialog requires the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission. Without it the button is not shown.”
